description: This file defines the JsonIPC class, which implements the ObjectIPC interface for handling JSON object-based inter-process communication (IPC). It provides methods to convert to and from JSON representations, encapsulating a JSONObject.

classes.name: JsonIPC
classes.description: A class that implements ObjectIPC, allowing JSON object encapsulation and conversion for inter-process communication.

methods.name: JsonIPC(JSONObject val)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a given JSONObject.

methods.name: toJSON()
methods.description: Converts the object to a JSON representation, wrapping the internal JSONObject with a key.

methods.name: fromJSON(JSONObject buffer)
methods.description: Initializes the object from a JSON object, extracting the internal JSONObject.
